1. **Chart type**: Annotated scientific simulation diagram / cross-sectional field visualization using colored bands rather than a standard statistical chart.

2. **Layout techniques**:  
- No faceting or small multiples in the main figure.  
- Layered/overlaid colored regions radiate from the central rocket, showing multiple wave/cone boundaries.  
- Includes a small inset timeline-like graphic at bottom right for launch noise vs. triple boom timing.

3. **Data variables**

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Position relative to booster (space around rocket) | Spatial/continuous | 2D position in the diagram |
| Pressure level (high vs. low) | Quantitative (diverging magnitude/sign) | Color/hue: red = high pressure, blue = low pressure |
| Boom/wave feature type (Leading edge boom, Pressure change, Trailing edge boom) | Categorical/nominal | Text labels with numbered callouts pointing to specific bands |
| Booster component (fins, landing legs, engines, Falcon 9 first stage booster) | Categorical/nominal | Direct text labels attached to parts of the rocket illustration |
| Time since launch (in inset) | Temporal | Position on x-axis in the inset |
| Sound amplitude / noise intensity (in inset waveform) | Quantitative | Vertical extent/height of waveform in the inset |
| Event labels in inset (Launch noise, Triple boom, Liftoff) | Categorical/nominal | Text annotations on the inset |
